grid=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in s.splitlines()]
# frames by connected components of nonzero; identify rectangles bbox and full perimeter.
def transform(g):
 import copy
 out=copy.deepcopy(g); H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); seen=set(); frames=[]
 for r in range(H):
  for c in range(W):
   v=g[r][c]
   if not v or (r,c) in seen: continue
   stack=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
   while stack:
    x,y=stack.pop();cells.append((x,y))
    for a,b in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
     if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]==v and (a,b) not in seen: seen.add((a,b));stack.append((a,b))
   rs=[x for x,y in cells]; cs=[y for x,y in cells]; top,bot,left,right=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
   if bot-top>=2 and right-left>=2 and all(g[top][y]==v and g[bot][y]==v for y in range(left,right+1)) and all(g[x][left]==v and g[x][right]==v for x in range(top,bot+1)):
    frames.append((top,bot,left,right,v))
 # source frame has nonzero nonborder interior
 src=None
 for t,b,l,r,v in frames:
  pat=[[g[x][y]!=0 for y in range(l+1,r)] for x in range(t+1,b)]
  if any(any(row) for row in pat): src=(t,b,l,r,v,pat); break
 if src:
  t,b,l,r,v,pat=src
  for T,B,L,R,V in frames:
   if (T,B,L,R)==(t,b,l,r):continue
   for i in range(min(B-T-1,len(pat))):
    for j in range(min(R-L-1,len(pat[i]))):
     if pat[i][j]:out[T+1+i][L+1+j]=V
 return out
out=transform(grid)
print('frames')
